primary_protocol.checkpoint_selection: lowest Dev loss within each frozen horizon

frozen_conclusion: Under the frozen Dev-loss checkpoint-selection protocol, L8 was the strongest evaluated factorial configuration on Dev across the three seeds. The expanded pool did not improve selected performance at the three-epoch horizon, while its duration gain was larger than the small pool's, yielding a positive pool-by-duration interaction.
terminal_checkpoint_sensitivity: At the terminal epoch-8 checkpoint, the L8-S8 mean difference was near zero (ERR -0.000138; F1 +0.000316; exact match -0.001905). Therefore the L8 result is frozen as an advantage under the selected-checkpoint protocol, not as a large unconditional terminal-epoch pool effect.
scope_limitations: Dev was used for checkpoint selection and reporting.
The previously observed ViLexNorm Test is not an independent confirmatory holdout.
C-max20-ES is exploratory optimization and cannot revise this factorial conclusion.
